title: Unified Habitability Index (UHI) v5.2.1
description: Code, dated NASA Exoplanet Archive snapshot, machine-readable results for 6112 planets, figures and RNAAS manuscript for the Unified Habitability Index (UHI) v5.2.1: the final manuscript of the v5.2 model (reference corrections and expanded AI disclosure; no scientific changes). A Dirichlet-weighted geometric mean of seven sub-indices evaluated by Monte Carlo. Code MIT; data, results and figures CC BY 4.0.
